title: GoldenSearchCase
description: Golden example of multi-market search semantics. Fixtures illustrate OpenSpec; they are not a competing source of truth. implementation_stage A-E marks staged work. Later-stage fixtures describe expected semantics and must not be treated as implemented. The provider field uses current BERA marketplace vocabulary. Structural PR A contracts remain provider-neutral.

implementation_stage.description: OpenSpec implementation PR that owns this semantic. A is the search-session core and is implemented. B-E remain unimplemented until their PRs land.

runtime_check.description: Selects exactly one runtime handler in tests/unit/test_ai_contracts.py. Unknown values fail. Later-stage B-E fixtures may keep runtime_check null.

items.description: Repository-relative path to an authoritative specification or architecture file. Must stay inside the repository root. Architecture refs supplement OpenSpec and do not replace it.
